subject: SkyBridge ISV marketplace: technical gating & exemption asks
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@skybridge.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: partner-ops@skybridge.ai
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SkyBridge marketplace listing — gating exceptions and urgent integration asks

Hi Markus and Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re excited to move forward with a listing on Redwood’s marketplace, but our product team hit two blockers during technical review and procurement:

1) Billing hooks / entitlement model — our billing runs through a third-party metering connector and the marketplace requires an entitlement flag at provisioning. We need a temporary exemption or an integration pattern that won’t require re-architecting production metering.

2) Security questionnaire — we need a short-path SOC2 evidence exchange and a limited-scope security review so procurement can sign SOW this quarter.

Can your team advise feasibility and any timeline tradeoffs? We’ll also share an API spec (internal) and a draft SOW — attaching the SOW stub.

Attachments: SkyBridge_SOW.pdf (stub)

Best,
Emily Zhao
Head of Partnerships, SkyBridge AI
emily.zhao@skybridge.ai
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@skybridge.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SkyBridge marketplace listing — gating exceptions and urgent integration asks

Team — looping you in to triage. Summary: SkyBridge is asking for (A) a billing/entitlement integration pattern or temporary exemption to avoid rework, and (B) an accelerated security evidence path so SOW can close this quarter.

Camila: product questions below — can you confirm whether a marketplace entitlement flag is strictly required for listing, or if we can accept a partner-provided entitlement callback paired with our marketplace record as a stopgap?
Jonas: partner ops — if we grant an exemption, what are the gating criteria and SLA commitments we must document?
Ben: infra/billing — is there an integration pattern (metering webhook -> marketplace entitlement reconciliation) that we can recommend?
Marissa: legal/finance — any quick notes on SOW sign-off with a conditional exemption?

Goal: get a short working session with SkyBridge next week and a proposed path to production by end of June. Emily — are you available Tue/Wed next week for a 30-minute technical sync?

Thanks,
Markus
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
From: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@skybridge.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SkyBridge marketplace listing — gating exceptions and urgent integration asks

Quick notes from Product (Camila):

- Entitlement requirement: The marketplace UI requires an entitlement flag to enable paid features. That said, we have an existing "external entitlement callback" pattern used for a handful of ISVs during pilot. It requires: a partner endpoint that responds to our entitlement checks (token exchange + customer_id => entitlement boolean) and an explicit TTL. It is not ideal long-term but acceptable as a timeboxed exemption.

- Metering & billing: Ben, the recommended pattern is to accept partner-metered usage via a verified callback and reconcile nightly into our billing ledger. That will need a contract clause for reconciliation windows and a simple signature of usage digest.

- Security: To expedite, ask SkyBridge to fill our reduced-scope questionnaire (PCI/PII sections omitted) and provide SOC2 summary PDF. We can do a "fast lane" review for marketplace listing if answers are complete.

I’m attaching the API stub that highlights the entitlement callback and example payloads. If SkyBridge can stand up that callback and sign temporary reconciliation terms we can move to a canary listing.

Attachments: sb_api_spec_v1.2.json

Action items:
- Emily: share partner endpoint + expected TTL and a primary contact for implementation.
- Ben: draft the reconciliation clause (1–2 paragraphs) we can append to SOW.
- Jonas/Markus: approve canary gating checklist below and confirm dates.

Camila
Senior Product Manager, Partner Integrations
From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@skybridge.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 11:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: SkyBridge marketplace listing — gating exceptions and urgent integration asks

Thanks Camila — adding ops/rollout perspective. Proposed phased plan (high level):

Phase 1 (Pilot / Canary) — Target: within 3 weeks
- Accept entitlement callback pattern (timeboxed 90 days).
- Require partner to sign the reconciliation clause + provide nightly usage digest endpoint.
- Limited pilot to 5 customers (region: us) and explicit canary monitoring in Console (token-level cost and latency).
- Fast-lane security review: SkyBridge supplies completed reduced questionnaire + SOC2 summary.

Phase 2 (Production listing) — Target: after successful pilot (30–60 days)
- Migrate to our native entitlement flow (we’ll provide migration guide).
- Full security evidence and audit completed.
- Marketplace billing hooks standardized.

Operational asks from SkyBridge: stable callback endpoint, daily usage digest, and a point-of-contact for incident coordination.

I’ll open a Jira ticket for the canary gating checklist and link it here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRT-912.

Jonas
Partner Operations Lead
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@skybridge.ai>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 14:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: SkyBridge marketplace listing — gating exceptions and urgent integration asks

Emily — thanks for the clear ask and for sharing the SOW. Agreed path below and next steps:

1) Short-term exemption: We will accept the entitlement callback pattern as a 90-day timeboxed exemption for a US canary limited to 5 customers. Requirements: stable partner callback, TTL, and nightly usage digest.
2) Security fast-lane: complete the reduced questionnaire and provide SOC2 summary. We’ll perform an expedited review once we have answers.
3) Legal & billing: Ben will draft a 2-paragraph reconciliation clause for the SOW; Marissa will confirm conditional sign-off language.
4) Timeline & meeting: Proposed technical sync Tue Jun 8, 10:00 AM PT. Please confirm.

Attachments included for signatures: SkyBridge_SOW.pdf, skybridge_security_questions.csv
DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abc123-skybridge-sow
Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRT-912

Action owners & due dates:
- Emily / SkyBridge: provide callback endpoint + fill questionnaire (due Jun 4).
- Ben: draft reconciliation clause (due Jun 4).
- Camila & Jonas: finalize canary checklist in Jira (due Jun 6).

If that looks good I’ll send the calendar invite after you confirm availability for Jun 8.

Thanks — looking forward to shipping this.

Markus
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
